attrs.description:
For initial explorations into alpha decay can help with the following learning goals:

Accessibility rating:
- allows alternate input
- allows pan and zoom
not accessible for...
Predict how a nucleus changes when it emits an alpha particle.
Explain the concept of a half-life, including the random nature of it. Compare decay for a single atom versus a large sample.
Describe how an alpha particle can escape the nucleus despite a potential-energy barrier.
Predict how much radioactive substance remains after a given time, or how much time has passed based on the amount remaining.
